name: Alligator Energy Limited
content: Alligator Energy Limited is an Australian exploration and development company focused on uranium and energy related minerals. The company's primary focus is on the Samphire Uranium Project in South Australia, which utilizes in-situ recovery methods. Additionally, Alligator Energy holds interests in the Big Lake Uranium Project in the Cooper Basin and the Alligator Rivers Uranium Province in the Northern Territory. Beyond uranium, the company explores for nickel, cobalt, and copper at its Piedmont Project in northern Italy, positioning itself as a diversified player in the clean energy minerals sector.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Greg HallMay 2015

Chief Executive Officer

Greg Hall is a Mining Engineer with over 35 years' experience in the resources sector, specifically in uranium, copper, and gold. He has held senior executive roles at WMC Resources and Rio Tinto, including as Mine Manager of Olympic Dam and Ranger Uranium Mine. He was the founding CEO of Toro Energy Limited and has served as a director of the Australian Uranium Association.

Andrea Marsland-SmithFebruary 2024

Chief Operating Officer

Dr. Andrea Marsland-Smith is a geologist with over 20 years' experience in the uranium industry. She was previously the Head of Exploration for Heathgate Resources (owner of the Beverley Uranium Mine) and is credited with the discovery of the Four Mile uranium deposit in South Australia.

Simon SlesarewichFebruary 2024

Chief Development Officer

Simon Slesarewich is a mining engineer with over 25 years' experience in the resources industry. He has held various executive and operational roles, including CEO of Northern Graphite and Boardwalk Resources. He has significant experience in project development and operations.

Andrea BettiOctober 2023

Company Secretary

Andrea Betti is an accounting and corporate governance professional with over 20 years' experience in the resources sector. she has acted as Company Secretary for several ASX-listed companies and has experience in corporate advisory and financial management.

Non-Executive Director

Mr. Lougher is a highly experienced mining executive with over 40 years of experience in the industry, including as CEO of Western Areas Limited.
